svg.text: DELLHOLLOW — the cinematic town: 17 shots, 315 walk surfaces, 21 camera seams

Every walkable metre is coloured by the SHOT that owns it. Ownership is by map record (landmark / walk edge), so coverage is total by construction — tools/cine_test.mjs proves it. Generated by tools/cine_map.mjs.

◆ camera position and aim ━ camera seam (a silent cut; band drawn to measured width) Panels: PLAN (x along-gorge, y cliff→river) and ELEVATION (x, height) — the town is a canyon wall, so it needs both.
— x -4..127m along the gorge, y -4..57m from the cliff face out to the river
— x along the gorge, height -7..42m (water ~0, the rim road at 24)
